standard-dialogue-after-creature-of-fenk.player: It is all you deserve. Lord Rologarth is master of this castle once more. Let him protect you - if he wants to.

standard-dialogue-after-the-great-brain-.npc: After talking with these monks and seeing your efforts to save them...I'm starting to regret my past actions.

standard-dialogue-after-the-great-brain-.player: Admittedly, most of us don't accidentally trip and sew a bunch of dead bodies together.

standard-dialogue-after-the-great-brain-.npc: I know...I think that my time here will be well spent trying to atone for what I did.
Thank you for helping me see the error of my ways, [player name].

standard-dialogue-after-the-great-brain-.text: You steal the Ring of Charos from Fenkenstrain.

standard-dialogue-after-the-great-brain-.npc: What do you think you're doing?
